production_review.point: Structural validation precedes Original. Prepared points require correct source stage/file coordinates, complete equal-width mapped endpoints and a continuous SpanFor proof. Synthetic markers/parentheses cannot borrow nearby locations.
production_review.registry_owner: Original=true metadata is owned by the source-built registry. Only structural validation is appropriate at the caller: two packages may use the same filename and the dependency may have offsets beyond the caller buffer. Zero-length registry sentinels are rejected. Foreign non-Original coordinates are rejected.
production_review.frame: Definition/invocation envelopes use proven original endpoints and forward ordering, not continuous-byte point semantics. Synthetic interior question markers do not invalidate a known frame. Any unknown frame clears the entire chain; input metadata is cloned and order retained.
production_review.independence: Both immediate Diagnostic failure and successful macro token provenance retain a validated Stack independently of Origin. DiagnosticsFile emits known frames for nil-Origin segments while retaining the generated/unmapped primary label and exact generated-file filtering.
production_review.scope: No change to macro binding, allocation/append/copy semantics, propagation lowering, refs rules, Compose or Format.
